items.title: Learn how AI is changing supply chain robotics
items.summary: The live webinar, "Robots in the Supply Chain," will take place Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 12 P.M. ET. The post Learn how AI is changing supply chain robotics appeared first on The Robot Report.

items.title: Boston Dynamics’ Atlas humanoid lands first non-automotive trial
